scope: Independent visual review of source-keys.png, design.png, revisions/keys-v2.png and source.json; four chronological still keys only. No playback or interpolation approval.

timed_key_evidence.evidence: Entry remains an oblique emergence through the doorway: the rear is occluded by the jamb and one front leg reaches down. The blunt muzzle and two long angular ears preserve the chosen silhouette vocabulary.
The body has emerged and the forelegs extend for the landing. Head and chest turn toward screen right, consistent with the source landing rather than introducing a different action.
The rabbit settles into a compact crouch facing right; the bent hindquarter and grounded forefeet make the support legible.
The head has passed out of the right edge, leaving the elongated rear torso, tail and folded hind feet visible. This preserves the source exit direction and crop.

protected_strengths: Clear entry, landing, settling and rightward exit across the keys.
Recognizable sparse rabbit design through angular ears, blunt muzzle and simple continuous body contour.
Doorway occlusion and attached limbs remain intelligible.
